title: The future of Philippine education is offline AI
description: THE most dangerous assumption in Philippine educational artificial intelligence (AI) is not that machines can think. It is that every Filipino can connect. Build AI around an always-on cloud and geography becomes a technical requirement for learning: signal first, subscription second, education third. In an archipelago, that is going about it backward. The technology must adapt to the country, not force it to adapt to the technology.
